name: Longer Out-Breath
description: Breathe in for four seconds and out for six, for six unhurried rounds.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Four seconds in, six seconds out, on Breathing Space.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Use as many rounds as feel good.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Breathe in as the shape grows, then let the breath out slowly while it shrinks.
If six seconds out is too long, breathe out a little faster. The shape is only a guide.
tips: Breathe in a way that feels easy. If anything feels uncomfortable, stop and breathe normally.
